title: AMOS Skill Manifest
description: Generated export (dist/amos-skill-manifest.json) that lets AMOS consume the CRE Skills Plugin as a governed skill layer without hardcoding any skill. Superset of dist/catalog.json carrying the v5 governance fields plus two code-computed crosswalks (runtime_role -> AMOS demoStatus, human_gate -> AMOS amos_signoff). STATIC export, no live coupling (ADR-0006). Generated by scripts/amos-manifest-build.py.

manifest_version.description: Semver of THIS manifest schema (independent of plugin_version).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601. Determinism-preserving: --as-of arg > $AMOS_MANIFEST_AS_OF > catalog generated_at; wall-clock only with --now.

repo.description: owner/name slug for GitHub deep links (e.g. src/skills/<id>/SKILL.md).

ref_namespaces.description: Allowed sourceRef roots (data-room/*, model/*). A skill's source_ref_policy.emits namespaces must match one of these (M-D2).

crosswalks.description: The two governance crosswalks emitted as data (not prose) so AMOS reads the projection directly. M-AM2 / M-AM3.

runtime_role_to_demo_status.description: 7 plugin runtime_role values -> 3 AMOS DemoStatus values. Total over the plugin enum.

human_gate_to_signoff.description: 6 plugin human_gate values -> 4 AMOS amos_signoff values. Total over the plugin enum.

debt_hedging_signoff_chain.description: ADR-0004 escalation chain applied to debt/hedging-exposed decision-grade skills.

_sample_note.description: Non-contract annotation, present only on the committed sample excerpt. The full generated manifest omits it.

SourceRefPolicy.description: Source-grounding posture (09 shape, M-D2). Null when the skill has no AMOS-facing grounding contract.

emits.description: sourceRef namespaces the skill writes (e.g. data-room/*, model/*, market/*).

on_unresolvable.description: Behavior when a required source reference cannot be resolved.

forbids_fabricated_model_ref.description: If true, the skill must never invent a model/* or data-room/* reference (ADR-0007 strict resolver).

SkillManifestEntry.description: One plugin item projected for AMOS: catalog identity + verbatim governance + the two computed crosswalks (demo_status, amos_signoff).

id.description: Plugin slug. PRIMARY KEY. Maps to PluginSkillRef.skillId, source-manifest extractionSkill, FeedbackItem.routedTo.

source_path.description: Repo-relative path; GitHub deep link is {repo}/blob/main/{source_path}.

version.description: Per-item semver from frontmatter; null if unset.

classification.description: Plugin v5 agent-ecosystem role. AMOS may bucket cards by it (replaces AMOS's deal-scoped origin).

runtime_role.description: How the skill executes (plugin enum). Crosswalked to demo_status.

decision_grade.description: Can emit a decision-grade artifact. Projection of frontmatter final_marked. Backs the AMOS tier-1 landing / committed deck slides.

human_gate.description: CRE-business-semantic gate (stays in the plugin, M-AM2). Crosswalked to amos_signoff.

amos_surface.description: AMOS RoomTabKey (+ landing/decision) placement. Source of truth: amos-prototype room-tabs.ts.

decomposes_to.description: Catalog ids this orchestrator/workspace composes (powers the workflow-timeline ordering).

composed_from.description: Inverse pointer: orchestrators/workspaces that use this item.

input_artifacts.description: Named CRE artifacts (OM, T-12, rent roll, ...). Binds docs->skill in the source map. Maps to PluginSkillRef.inputArtifacts.

outputs.description: Named CRE output artifacts (symmetric with input_artifacts). Maps to PluginSkillRef.outputArtifacts. v5.2: populated for artifact-producing / consumer-facing skills; [] where the item emits no named artifact.

calculator_file.description: Path to the stdlib calculator when runtime_role is deterministic; null otherwise.

produces_artifact_kind.description: v5.2 consumer-contract. PLUGIN-namespaced artifact family the item emits. Derived (calculator_file -> calculator_result, orchestrator -> workflow_plan) with frontmatter override; null where not yet declared. A consumer maps these to its own internal artifact registry via a crosswalk on its side; the plugin does not encode any consumer's registry slugs. Contract-only; no live coupling.

pii_policy.description: v5.2 consumer-contract (refined from the v5.1 forward-compat posture enum, which was never populated). Maximum PII/confidentiality sensitivity the item expects in inputs: none < business_contact < tenant_or_personal < sensitive_financial. CONSERVATIVE default 'none' (explicit-opt-in). PHI is intentionally absent — CRE Skills do not accept PHI. Distinct axis from the connector data-trust source_class vocabulary.

workspace_scope.description: v5.2 consumer-contract (widened from the v5.1 4-value RBAC set). CRE workspace the item operates within, for downstream filtering/grouping. Derived from subcategory/keywords with frontmatter override; null where unscoped. Contract-only; no live coupling.

demo_status.description: COMPUTED crosswalk of runtime_role -> AMOS DemoStatus (RUNTIME_ROLE_TO_DEMO_STATUS).

amos_signoff.description: COMPUTED crosswalk of human_gate -> AMOS sign-off (primary/highest required). Debt/hedging decision-grade skills escalate to external-attestation (ADR-0004).

amos_signoff_chain.description: COMPUTED ordered sign-off ladder up to the primary. Debt/hedging decision-grade skills carry [am-cfo-signoff, external-attestation].

live_connector.description: ALWAYS false. ADR-0006: AMOS references skills, it never invokes them live. The manifest never claims a live connector.
